messages:
kevin: Sable Systems opened a billing ticket. They say a pricing experiment rolled to prod and charged them at the experimental overage rate for April usage. They want a manual adjustment + refund for $3,750. Screenshot attached.
maria: Can you paste the invoice id and the lines affected?
kevin: INV-2026-0428-901. Line: OVERAGE-TOKENS (Apr 1-30) qty 1 unit price $18,750.00. Customer says the correct price should have been $15,000.00 after the standard discount, so they're requesting $3,750.00 refund.
lina: I can pull the deploy logs. We did a canary pricing experiment last week that inadvertently included a subset of subscribers. Looks like Sable was in the cohort. Eng-analytics will confirm which cohort and rollback timeline.
eng-analytics: Confirmed: experiment PR#5322 shipped an A/B price change at 2026-04-20 03:04Z. Customer cust_9ZHT was served variant B for the duration Apr 20-30. That's why higher charge.
frank: From an ops perspective, we can issue a retrospective credit equal to the delta. Since amount is <$5k, manager approval is fine; no legal required per FIN-REF-3 thresholds.
maria: Ok. Need: 1) engineering note that it was experiment-induced, 2) sales or account contact to approve goodwill adjustment, 3) a short memo in the ledger for audit. kevin, can you get the account owner sign-off?
kevin: Pinged account owner Hannah; she replied: "Please proceed with the $3,750 refund and apply a permanent pricing override so Sable isn't in the experiment cohort again." Copying her reply here.
lina: Filed ENG-EXPT-2026-77 to roll back cohort and add exclusion rule. Assigned eng-analytics. ETA: 24h for complete backfill checks.
frank: Operational steps I'll run after approval:
```nbilling-tool credit-create --customer cust_9ZHT --invoice INV-2026-0428-901 --amount 3750.00 --currency USD --reason "Pricing experiment overcharge (Apr) - delta refund" --gl-code REV-ADJ
billing-tool refund-issue --customer cust_9ZHT --amount 3750.00 --method stripe --note "Refund for pricing experiment overcharge"
```
maria: I approve the $3,750 adjustment. Please include ENG-EXPT-2026-77 in the ticket for audit and add the account owner's confirmation.
eng-analytics: Added experiment ticket link ENG-EXPT-2026-77 to the billing note.
finance-bot: Ledger note created: credit memo cm_993b7 for cust_9ZHT amount 3750.00.
frank: Ran credit-create and refund-issue commands. Refund txn id refund_txn_c3a9f posted; status pending_settlement.
sable-support: Thanks, team. Hannah appreciates the quick turnaround. Please confirm the permanent exclusion has been applied.
lina: Exclusion rule applied and verified for cust_9ZHT. Will monitor cohort metrics for 48h.
maria: Closing note for audit: Approved $3,750 goodwill adjustment for Sable Systems due to inadvertent pricing experiment inclusion. ENG-EXPT-2026-77 created; account owner confirmed. Finance processed refund_txn_c3a9f pending settlement.
